title: 🚨 IF YOUR CHURCH CAN’T FUNCTION WITHOUT YOU, YOU HAVEN’T FINISHED BUILDING IT.
paragraphs: 🚨 IF YOUR CHURCH CAN’T FUNCTION WITHOUT YOU, YOU HAVEN’T FINISHED BUILDING IT.
But every pastor, church planter, and ministry leader needs to wrestle with this question:
What would happen to the ministry if you disappeared for 90 days?
Would people still be cared for?
Or would everything start falling apart because you became the system?

HOW TO BUILD A CHURCH THAT CAN FUNCTION WITHOUT YOU
From Pastor-Dependent Ministry to a Christ-Centered Culture of Disciples, Leaders, and Multiplication
Jesus never intended one leader to carry the entire church.
And before ascending, He commissioned them to make more disciples.
“And what you have heard from me... entrust to faithful men, who will be able to teach others also.” — 2 Timothy 2:2
You’ll learn the difference between building a ministry around your gift and building people around Christ.
Most celebrate how much the pastor can do.
Few ask how much the pastor has equipped others to do.
Few build for the next generation.
Your greatest legacy will not be that people couldn't function without you.
It will be that because you faithfully equipped them, they learned to follow Christ, serve others, raise leaders, and make disciples.
We are building a movement of believers who refuse to remain spectators.
Churches centered on Christ rather than personalities.
And believers determined to carry the Gospel forward.

Build disciples.
Raise leaders.
Release ministry.
Multiply the mission.
Christ must remain the Head of His Church.
